outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram illustrating the experimental pipeline; it is not a data plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B consists of fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data, so this check does not apply.
Panel C is a bar chart showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI for Normal lung, LUAD, and LUSC groups, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid on each bar.
Panel D is a bar chart showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI for High pH and Low pH regions, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid on each bar.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, not a data plot, so this check does not apply.
